Three old-main regressions fail; all four new actual restricted-migration groups and 38 ordinary tests/typecheck/build/registry pass. All eleven scheduler/deadline groups pass through freshly packed installed compiled public exports. Initial source03b2cacd125cc744dba8e525f5fdec98cb9189af passed CI40585534725/job122475823408 (38 groups), logs inspected. All final-head CI remains required. No real receipt/liveness/live clock/deployed worker qualification. Partial PR8 adds explicit consumeCurrent with required trusted live clock sampled after project-lock/stored-state read. Legacy consume remains caller-time compatible; both lock before reading. Four new restricted-migration embedded groups cover expiry, clock failure, lost acknowledgement and capture. Network/deployed clock/current identity/receipt/worker qualification and other scheduler live-clock operations remain pending. Partial PR10 adds explicit leaseNextCurrent clock sampling after locked state read, live lease/attempt timestamps and source expiry. Legacy leaseNext and fingerprints preserved; cached replay remains historical, requiring separate current consumption. Five new restricted-migration groups; other operation clocks, real network/worker/Identity/receipt services remain pending. Partial PR11 adds recoverCurrent with required post-lock/post-read trusted clock; consumed uncertainty remains capacity-blocked until verified completion, legacy recovery/fingerprints preserved and cached results historical. Four new restricted-migration groups. Independent TCP-session/current Identity/clock/receipt/worker/liveness and production qualification remain pending.
